system.description:
Your skin becomes flexible stone — soft and lifelike to the eye, retaining its muscle tone and warmth, yet swords shatter against it and bullets flatten and fall away.

Spend two Blood Traits to activate it instantly; the effect lasts for the remainder of the scene. All incoming physical damage — fists, claws, blades, firearms, explosions — is halved (round up), though fire, sunlight and magic are unaffected (a magical effect that hurls a physical object still counts as physical). Bashing attacks lose one health level of damage before the halving. Any sword or similar melee weapon used against you risks shattering: its wielder makes a Simple Test and, unless the weapon is exceptionally well-manufactured, it breaks on a loss.
